mapper.select: SELECT f.*, b.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, w.warehouse_type, b.project_no, b.project_name, b.material_code, b.material_name, b.project_material_sku, b.material_category, b.color, b.model, b.uom FROM inventory_age_batch_fact f JOIN warehouse_sku_base b ON b.warehouse_sku_key = f.warehouse_sku_key JOIN warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = b.warehouse_id ORDER BY f.snapshot_date DESC, b.warehouse_id, f.age_batch_id
